# Contributing to NetSpeed

Thank you for helping make NetSpeed better! Here are all the ways you can contribute.

---

## 🐛 Report a bug

1. Make sure the bug hasn't been reported yet:
   - Search the existing [Issues](https://github.com/nvstarikov/netspeed/issues)
   - Check the [Discussions](https://github.com/nvstarikov/netspeed/discussions)
2. If it's new, describe it in detail:
   - **Version of NetSpeed** (shown on startup)
   - **Windows version** (10 or 11)
   - **Connection type** (Ethernet / Wi-Fi / mobile)
   - **Steps to reproduce:** what you did → what you expected → what actually happened
3. Attach supporting information:
   - Last 2–3 entries from `netspeed_history.md`
   - A screenshot of the terminal if the issue is visual
   - Your ISP name and plan speed (in Mbps)

> The more detail you provide, the faster we can fix it.

---

## 💡 Suggest a feature

Have an idea to improve NetSpeed?

Describe:
- **What** you want to add
- **Why** it matters (what problem it solves)
- **How** it might look (optional — a sketch or mockup helps)

We read everything. Even if we don't implement it immediately, your idea stays in the backlog.

---

## 🌍 Help with translation

NetSpeed currently supports **Russian** and **English**.

Want to add a third language? We're looking for:
- 🇩🇪 German
- 🇫🇷 French
- 🇨🇳 Chinese
- 🇪🇸 Spanish

Write to **support@stargrd.ru** with the subject line `NetSpeed translation — <language>` — we'll discuss the format and timeline.

---

## 🧪 Test a pre-release

Before every public release, we run closed beta tests.

Want to be a beta tester?
- Join the [community forum](https://stargrd.ru/forum/)
- Subscribe to the **NetSpeed** section
- You'll get early builds + direct feedback channel to the developer

Your testing effort directly shapes the release.

---

## 📖 Improve documentation

Found a typo in the README? Missing a step in the installation guide?

1. Click **Fork** (top right)
2. Edit `README.md` or `README_EN.md` in your fork (pencil icon)
3. **Commit changes** in your fork
4. Return to the original repository → **Pull requests → New pull request**
5. Describe your changes and submit

**Rules for pull requests:**
- One change — one PR
- Commit message format: `docs: fixed typo in Installation section`
- No mass reformats "for beauty" — only what's relevant

---

## 💬 Join the community

Head to the [СТАРГРАДД forum](https://stargrd.ru/forum/):

- **NetSpeed section** — product discussions and feedback
- **Ideas** — propose improvements
- **Q&A** — ask questions and get answers from the team
- **News** — announcements and release notes

---

## ⭐ Star the repository

The simplest way to help — click ⭐ in the top-right corner of the repository.

Stars help NetSpeed appear in GitHub search and recommendations, bringing in new users who face the same problems you do.

---

## 📣 Spread the word

- Share the link on social media and relevant communities
- Write a post on your blog or forum
- Tell friends who could use the tool
